title: Does High Humidity Raise Your Blood Pressure?
description: Yes — studies show BP can spike up to 10 mmHg during humid heatwaves (>70% RH). Learn how to monitor and protect yourself, especially if you're over 35.
reasoning: A recent summer heatwave across the U.S. and Europe has triggered widespread concern among adults 35+ about unexplained BP spikes — users want practical, age-specific guidance on managing cardiovascular risk when humidity climbs, not clinical jargon.
